step02-quiesce-and-final-backup: systemctl stop terrace-cms-sweep.timer terrace-cms-sweep.service terrace-web.service terrace-cms.service keycloak.service nginx.service
step06-push: terrace-secrets push app --address <replacement address> --identity <operator ssh key>
step12-postgresql: install -d -m 0700 -o postgres -g postgres "$pg_dir" && cp -a /var/lib/terrace-restore/pgdata/. "$pg_dir"/ && chown -R postgres:postgres "$pg_dir"
step14-role-checks: runuser -u postgres -- psql -XAt -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d postgres -c "select rolsuper and rolcanlogin from pg_authid where oid=10 and rolname='postgres'"   # t
runuser -u postgres -- psql -XAt -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d postgres -c "select count(*) from pg_roles where rolname='terrace-restore'"   # 0
runuser -u postgres -- psql -XAt -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d postgres -c "show fsync"   # on
runuser -u postgres -- psql -XAt -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d postgres -c "show hba_file"   # a /nix/store path
runuser -u terrace-restore -- psql -X -w -h /run/postgresql -U postgres -d postgres -c 'select 1'   # must FAIL
step16-migration-gate: runuser -u postgres -- psql -XAt -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d terrace_cms -c 'select name||batch from payload_migrations order by id'
runuser -u postgres -- psql -XAt -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d terrace_cms -c 'select name||batch from payload_migrations order by id'
d5-app: systemctl is-active terrace-backup.timer terrace-backup-check.timer terrace-backup-freshness.timer terrace-cms-sweep.timer

step15-output-app: Adopted: the writers start now and at every boot.
Held until you have verified the restored services: terrace-backup.timer terrace-backup-check.timer terrace-backup-freshness.timer (they stay off across reboots).
Held until the replacement is declared in service, after any erasure replay: terrace-cms-sweep.timer (they stay off across reboots).
Arm it then with: terrace-production arm-timers --in-service
step21-output-app: Still held until the replacement is declared in service: terrace-cms-sweep.timer. Arm with: terrace-production arm-timers --in-service
